returnToPanelLabel: Return the preview to the panel

empty.title: No preview open
empty.body: Choose an HTML file in Files and open its preview. The page runs sandboxed and can’t touch h4rn, its cookies or its storage.

missing_one: {{count, number}} file wasn’t loaded: it is missing, outside the workspace, or over the size limit.
missing_other: {{count, number}} files weren’t loaded: they are missing, outside the workspace, or over the size limit.

scripts.deviceTitle: This device can’t run scripts in a preview.
scripts.deviceBody: Its WebView blocks a sandboxed page’s own scripts, so the preview was turned off instead of showing the page without them. Update Android System WebView, then reload.
scripts.unknownBody: The app couldn’t read this WebView’s capability report, so it can’t confirm the page’s scripts will run. Reload to check again.
scripts.blockedBody: The page loaded, but the script that keeps its links safe never ran. Reload the preview; a comment that is never closed, or a policy that blocks scripts, can cause this.

failure.goneTitle: This file is no longer in the workspace.
failure.documentTooLargeTitle: This file is too large to preview.
failure.documentTooLarge: The preview reads at most {{limit}}; this file is {{size}}. Open it in a browser instead.
failure.documentTooLargeEscaped: This file is {{size}}, too large to preview once its text is escaped for transfer. Open it in a browser instead.
failure.pageTooLargeTitle: This page is too large to preview.
failure.pageTooLarge: The prepared page is {{size}}; the preview embeds up to {{limit}} from the workspace.
failure.binary: Only text HTML files can be previewed.
failure.undecodable: The daemon could not decode it as text.
